721430101.text: Hello, guests from afar. My name is Tsuyuko, and I am a shrine maiden at the Sangonomiya Shrine. Are you here to help?

721430103.text: We've only just met! What does she mean, "help"?

721430105.text: It's just that I made a wish previously, and according to the divination result, there will always be help on the way whenever I am troubled or having a hard time.

721430106.text: So you, O helpful guests, must be here to assist me, right?

721430108.text: Well, whatever, let's just hear what she has to say first...

721430111.text: Thank you so much, then. Let me give you the backstory.

721430112.text: The deep pool directly across from the Sangonomiya Shrine is the entrance to Enkanomiya. Legend has it that this place was the origin of the Watatsumi people.

721430113.text: In days of old, the beauties of Watatsumi were renowned for their soft skin, which would conceal seven types of skin blemish...

721430114.text: ...This, of course, being mostly a consequence of our ancestors' lack of sunlight in the depths of Enkanomiya...

721430110.text: How is this any way to ask for help...

721430201.text: You're back. Is there something I can do for you?

721430203.text: The <color=#00E1FFFF>"eye"</color> is on the <color=#00E1FFFF>island to the west</color>, the <color=#00E1FFFF>"fang"</color> is on the <color=#00E1FFFF>northwest coast</color>, the <color=#00E1FFFF>"fin"</color> is on the <color=#00E1FFFF>coast due north</color>, and the <color=#00E1FFFF>"tail"</color> is on the <color=#00E1FFFF>shoal in the southeast</color>.

721430204.text: Near each of the four seals is a stone tablet that records ritual-related matters... But they have stood for many an age, and the handwriting is now barely legible.

721430205.text: By obtaining the four "Spirit Pearls" of these four seals, you can unlock the seal of the "heart".

721430214.text: And at the appointed, critical time, we break the barrier, retrieve the Jade Coral Branch, perform the Watatsumi Mitama Omatsuri ritual...

721430215.text: ...But the knowledge I gained at the Akademiya tells me that the spread of Holy Soil is due to Watatsumi Island's geological make-up.

721430216.text: As the seawater encroaches on land, the soil dries and hardens. The saline and alkaline components will leach the land's nutrients away and render the soil inert, thus rendering it no longer suitable for agriculture.

721430217.text: The Jade Coral Branches contain Omikami's power, and they can replenish the missing elements in the soil, thus staving off the effects of bleaching.

721430207.text: Ah, you must want to know why these seals are named the way they are?

721430208.text: The Omikami has an envoy, and the clergy set a seal upon its skeleton and used its power to break the connection between Watatsumi and Enkanomiya.

721430209.text: If you don't believe me, you can look at the map yourself. The bulge on the left is the "eye" and the one stretching out at the bottom right is the "tail"...

721430210.text: Okay, don't look at me like that! That's the explanation I got from my fellow shrine maidens! It's hard for me to accept it too!

721430212.text: Basically, the bleaching of the soil is said to be due to absorption of the spirit of Watatsumi Island by Byakuyakoku. If it sinks all the way to the bottom, then Watatsumi will become a desert.

721430213.text: But thanks to the suppressive power of Sangonomiya Shrine and our Omikami's might, which our Divine Priestess has inherited, this Holy Soil has not spread to encompass the rest of the island.
